snippet.title: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
"When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth."                                         — Sherlock Holmes

Step into a groundbreaking mystery-deduction experience where the core gameplay is powered by the latest cutting-edge AI. As Sherlock Holmes, you will engage in a battle of wits against dozens of AI-driven characters to uncover clues and crack the case.

Every piece of evidence is yours to find. As the world-renowned detective, you will gather information through dynamic conversation, interrogation, emotional manipulation, and environmental puzzles. From major players to minor suspects, every character possesses a fully realized persona—complete with their own history, secrets, and relationships.

Experience unprecedented immersion as characters respond to your inquiries in real-time with expressive emotions and lifelike dialogue. Transport yourself to the heart of Victorian London; you are the only one who can change the course of the story. You are "Sherlock Holmes".
